This card shows the ENGINE's own role state: the five lifecycle words and every derived value come from scripts/lib/roles.mjs and its CLI, never from a second vocabulary typed into a page. The externalized config is read-only here (spec §9), and changing an address or a network is a CLI/operator step only. Lifecycle (source: STAKE_STATES in scripts/lib/roles.mjs): none → acquired → staked → revoking → claimable. The page repeats these five words verbatim so that a drift is visible, and revoking derives to claimable at read time once claimableAt has passed — the record itself is not rewritten. Every state here is operator-declared: setting staked does NOT activate a role. Until a verifier exists every chain role stays active=false and its capabilities stay withheld (fail closed, spec §114/§115). This card never asserts that a role is active. STAKE_STATES）：none → acquired → staked → revoking → claimable。本页逐字重复这五个词，漂移即可见；revoking 在 claimableAt 到期后于读取时派生为 claimable——记录本身不被改写。 这些状态都是 operator 声明的：把状态设为 staked **不会**激活角色。在验证器接通前，每个链角色始终 active=false、能力始终 withheld（fail closed，spec §114/§115）。本卡片绝不断言某角色已激活。 外部化配置（只读） 集合地址、网络、assetType 与已声明生命周期都是记录取值（config/roles.json，spec §9，仅管理员）。本页只做展示；记录才是权威，下方 CLI 是唯一的修改入口。 chainVerification —
